BiblicalUsage: ʼAb is the ordinary word for father, and it carries weight far beyond biology. A father gives the family its name, its inheritance and its protection, and Scripture uses that picture for God Himself — the Father who bought Israel, defends the fatherless, and is honoured by His sons.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fatherhood tells us who God is before it tells us who we are. He is not a distant judge first; He is the Father who provides, corrects and keeps. That is why the loss or failure of an earthly father hurts so deeply — and why knowing God as Father heals it.
